svg.title: Marroway authored settlement plan
svg.desc: Twenty-four named places and district envelopes. Lines represent service dependencies, not surveyed routes. No constructed city is claimed.
svg.text: CITY-002 · 742 AL · 670,000 core residents, authored estimate · settlement proposal v1
North is up · coordinates in kilometers · z is planning sea-level altitude · no surveyed terrain or operating service capacity
Neris, Serrit and Low Cut joined planning water
Cream labels: places. Dark labels: district
points are dry interchanges; actual berths
and access legs remain to be designed.
110 km² gross allocation; district ellipses overlap and are not measured parcel areas.
Local surfaces and heights are authored controls. Floods, depths, gradients, structures and service capacity require separate work.
Source: marroway_settlement.json · spherical AEQD at 4° latitude, 29° longitude
This plate locates a proposal; it does not show a built or simulated city.
